'''Kenyon Ellefson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 Tucson tournament]] on 29 April 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]] and [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]], according to Enrique Huerta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d643">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-tucson-az-04-29-00d643/ tucson-az-04-29-00], DeckTech (Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta, 1 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-tucson-az-04-29-00d643/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
